mapper.select:
select distinct d.TRADE_ID as tradeId,
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr, d.PS as psCode, d.PS as ps, DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as confirmDate, d.SHARE_AMT as shareAmt, d.FEE_AMT as feeAmt, d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as bookDate, d.CCY as ccyCode, d.CCY as ccy,
d.INT_AMT as intAmt, DATE_FORMAT(d.cprice_Date,'%Y-%m-%d') as cpriceDate, d.UNIT_CPRICE as unitCprice, DATE_FORMAT(d.SETTLE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate, (case when d.PS = 'T24' then DATE_FORMAT(stl.SETTLE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') end) AS realDate, d.TRADE_AMT as cashAmt, d.Prin_Amt as bonusAmt, d.SHARE_AMT as bonusShare, d.INT_AMT as bAmt, d.INT_AMT as realAmt, d.TRADE_AMT as prinAmt, d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,
d.CHL_ID as chlId,
d.UNIT_INT as unitInt, d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarketCode, d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, e.R_FINPROD_ID as rFinprodId, ( CASE WHEN instr('B09', tdf.fee_type) >0 THEN tdf.FEE_AMT ELSE NULL END ) as tdFeeAmt, ( CASE WHEN instr('B09', tdf.fee_type) >0 THEN tdf.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE ELSE NULL END ) as isPayWithTrade, ( CASE WHEN instr('B05', tdf.fee_type) >0 THEN tdf.FEE_AMT ELSE NULL END ) as tdFeeAmt2, ( CASE WHEN instr('B05', tdf.fee_type) >0 THEN tdf.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE ELSE NULL END ) as isPayWithTrade2, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d inner join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type in ('B09','B05') left join STL_ORDERS stl on stl.TRADE_ID = d.TRADE_ID and d.PS = 'T24' left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
